notes.title: Timewalk Tower Defense is going Free to Play!
notes.notes:
Hello Timewalk Heroes!

Shortly, Timewalk Tower Defense will be going free to play.  We want to give as many people as possible the chance to stop the evil Space Emporor Zoj, so the price of entry to the timeways is being removed.  We hope you all enjoy trying out the diverse skillsets and defenses the heroes bring to the table, and good luck in your battle to save the timelines!

-The Maxeymus Games Team
